templates.template: Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades
templates.name: Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades

triggers.expression: find(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/os.release.codename,,"regexp","{$OS.EOL.WARN.CODENAMES}")=1
triggers.name: OS approaching end-of-life: {HOST.NAME} running {?last(/{HOST.HOST}/os.release.pretty_name)}

triggers.expression: find(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/os.release.id_point,,"regexp","^ubuntu:")=1 and find(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/os.release.id_point,,"regexp","{$OS.LATEST.POINT}")=0
triggers.name: OS behind latest point release: {HOST.NAME} on {ITEM.LASTVALUE1}

triggers.expression: change(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/os.release.pretty_name)=1
triggers.name: Release Changed on {HOST.NAME}

items.name: Facter
items.description: User facter to find out, well, facts about this system

triggers.expression: find(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/system.run[/usr/bin/facter],,"like","jessie")=1 or find(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/system.run[/usr/bin/facter],,"like","trusty")=1 or find(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/system.run[/usr/bin/facter],,"like","precise")=1
triggers.name: Hey! {HOST.NAME} has a pending Distribution Upgrade
triggers.description: We can add EOL distros here, and then it will trigger an alert. Please be aware that for example, 16.04 might be out of date, but also supported. Take htis into account before adding another OS.

items.name: HWE Support Status
items.description:
hwe-support-status --verbose will output info such as:

Your Hardware Enablement Stack (HWE) is supported until April 2019.

WARNING: Security updates for your current Hardware Enablement Stack 
ended on 2016-08-04:  (not support HWE raise a critical alert sincen o more swecurity updates)

You are not running a system with a Hardware Enablement Stack. Your system is supported until April 2019. (not using HWE)

items.name: Distro Code Name
items.description:
Grab the distribution codename. E.g. stretch, buster, bionic, xenial etc.

Required as not all the parameters in the 50unattended-upgrades file exist in all the distros.

triggers.expression: last(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/system.run[/usr/bin/lsb_release -c])="Noble"
triggers.name: Ubuntu LTS Check
triggers.description: Host needs upgraded to the Latest Ubuntu LTS

items.name: Distro ID
items.description:
Grab the distribution ID. E.g. Debian, Ubuntu, etc.

Required as not all the parameters in the 50unattended-upgrades file exist in all the distros.

items.name: Ubuntu Server Metapackage
items.description: find out if the ubuntu server metapackage is installed. we list them all then do a regex match to find just that line

items.name: apt-check output
items.description: https://www.zabbix.com/forum/showthread.php?t=12576

items.name: Kernel Build
items.description:
This Value will rturn the Linux OS String. From there, we write triggers to aler if build is less than:

4.8.0-26.28 for Ubuntu 16.10
4.4.0-45.66 for Ubuntu 16.04 LTS
3.13.0-100.147 for Ubuntu 14.04 LTS
3.2.0-113.155 for Ubuntu 12.04 LTS
3.16.36-1+deb8u2 for Debian 8
3.2.82-1 for Debian 7
4.7.8-1 for Debian unstable

items.name: /etc/sudoers checksum
items.description: get checksum of /etc/sudoers to see if it's been tampered with

triggers.expression: (last(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/vfs.file.cksum[/etc/sudoers],#1)<>last(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/vfs.file.cksum[/etc/sudoers],#2))>0
triggers.name: /etc/sudoers has been changed on {HOST.NAME}

triggers.expression: nodata(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/vfs.file.contents[/etc/os-release],3h)=1
triggers.name: No data received from OS release checks for 1 hour

items.name: Debian Base OS
items.description: If /etc/debian_version exists, then we are running Debian, not Ubuntu. This will comei nto play when using triggers for certain packages.

items.name: Unattended Upgrades MOTD notifier
items.description: /etc/update-motd.d/90-updates-available needs to exist or update-notifier-common package is not installed so you don't get a MOTD notification as a fall back for unattended upgrades

items.name: Aptitude Package
items.description: aptitude is needed by the purge-old-kernels.sh script

triggers.expression: last(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/vfs.file.exists[/usr/bin/aptitude])=0
triggers.name: Hey! {HOST.NAME} has no aptitude package installed
triggers.description: If /usr/bin/aptitude binary doesn't exist then package aptitude is not installed and therefore, alert us to this fact.

items.name: Facter Package
items.description: Checks if host needs a reboot presence of file confirms it does

triggers.expression: last(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/vfs.file.exists[/usr/bin/facter])=0
triggers.name: Hey! {HOST.NAME} has no facter package installed
triggers.description: If /usr/bin/facter binary doesn't exist then package facter is not installed and therefore, alert us to this fact.

items.name: Unattended Upgrade Packages
items.description: If this binary does not exist then unattended-upgrades package is not installed

triggers.expression: last(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/vfs.file.exists[/usr/bin/unattended-upgrade])=0
triggers.name: Hey! {HOST.NAME} has no unattended-upgrades package installed
triggers.description: If /usr/bin/unattended-upgrade binary doesn't exist then package unattended-upgrades is not installed and therefore, alert us to this fact.

items.name: Zabbix Get Package
items.description: If this binary does not exist then zabbix-get is not installed

triggers.expression: last(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/vfs.file.exists[/usr/bin/zabbix_get])=0
triggers.name: Hey! {HOST.NAME} has no zabbix-get package installed
triggers.description: If /usr/bin/zabbix_get binary doesn't exist then package zabbix-get is not installed and therefore, alert us to this fact.

items.name: Unattended Upgrades Clean old kernels
items.description: /usr/local/bin/purge-old-kernels.sh needs to exist or update-notifier-common package is not installed so you don't get a MOTD notification as a fall back for unattended upgrades

triggers.expression: last(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/vfs.file.exists[/usr/local/bin/purge-old-kernels.sh])=0
triggers.name: Hey! {HOST.NAME} has no purge-old-kernels.sh script installed
triggers.description: If /usr/local/bin/purge-old-kernels.sh file doesn't exist then package update-notifier-common is not installed and therefore, alert us to this fact.

items.name: Unattended Upgrades auto-fix dpkg enabled
items.description: ensure /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/50unattended-upgrades has the  Unattended-Upgrade::AutoFixInterruptedDpkg "true"; line uncommented

triggers.expression: last(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/vfs.file.regmatch[/etc/apt/apt.conf.d/50unattended-upgrades,Unattended-Upgrade\:\:AutoFixInterruptedDpkg\s+\"true\"\;,UTF8,,])=0
triggers.name: Hey! {HOST.NAME} auto-fix dpkg not enabled in /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/50unattended-upgrades
triggers.description: If auto-fix dpkg is not enabled in /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/50unattended-upgrades throw an alert

items.name: Unattended Upgrades remove unused dependencies enabled
items.description: ensure /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/50unattended-upgrades has the //Unattended-Upgrade::Remove-Unused-Dependencies "true"; line uncommented

triggers.expression: last(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/vfs.file.regmatch[/etc/apt/apt.conf.d/50unattended-upgrades,Unattended-Upgrade\:\:Remove-Unused-Dependencies\s+\"true\"\;,UTF8,,])=0
triggers.name: Hey! {HOST.NAME} Remove-Unused-Dependencies not enabled in /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/50unattended-upgrades
triggers.description: if Remove-Unused-Dependencies is not enabled in /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/50unattended-upgrades throw an alert

items.name: Unattended Upgrades Remove-Unused-Kernel-Packages dpkg enabled
items.description: ensure /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/50unattended-upgrades has the Remove-Unused-Kernel-Packages "true"; line uncommented

items.name: Ubuntu Unattended Upgrades non-security updates enabled
items.description: ensure /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/50unattended-upgrades has the  "${distro_id}:${distro_codename}-updates"; uncommented

items.name: Debian Unattended Upgrades security updates enabled
items.description:
ensure /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/50unattended-upgrades has the          "origin=Debian,codename=${distro_codename},label=Debian-Security";

I have used \W for non-word character as \, passed regex tests online but made zabbix say too many parameters.

This is the debian check as it differs somewha from the Ubuntu check syntax.

Triggers take account of both.

items.name: Debian Unattended Upgrades non-security updates enabled
items.description:
ensure /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/50unattended-upgrades has the
      "o=Debian,a=stable-updates";

I have used \W for non-word character as \, passed regex tests online but made zabbix say too many parameters.

This is the debian check as it differs somewha from the Ubuntu check syntax.

Triggers take account of both.

items.name: Ubuntu Unattended Upgrades security updates enabled
items.description:
ensure /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/50unattended-upgrades has the  "${distro_id}:${distro_codename}-security"; uncommented

This is the Ubuntu item.

items.name: Unattended Upgrades Kernel Purge cron job
items.description: /var/spool/cron/crontabs/root must contain the cron job for alert to clear.

triggers.expression: last(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/vfs.file.regmatch[/etc/crontab,purge-old-kernels,UTF8,,],#1)=0
triggers.name: Hey {HOST.NAME} has no purge old kernels cron job
triggers.description: /etc/crontab must contain the line 00 7   *   *   *    /usr/local/bin/purge-old-kernels.sh --keep 2 for this check to be OK. This will clean the kernels at 07:00 each morning.

items.name: Remote Commands Enabled Zabbix Agent
items.description: EnableRemoteCommands=1 must exist in agent config or Facter checks will not work

items.name: Unattended Upgrades Update notifier Zabbix Agent
items.description: /var/spool/cron/crontabs/root must contain the cron job for alert to clear.

triggers.expression: last(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/vfs.file.regmatch[/etc/zabbix/zabbix_agentd.conf,update-notifier,UTF8,,],#1)=1
triggers.name: Hey {HOST.NAME} has the Update Notifier Zabbix UserParameter please remove

triggers.expression: find(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/system.run[/usr/bin/tasksel --list-tasks | /bin/grep 'Basic Ubuntu server'],,"regexp","^i")=0 and find(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/system.run[/usr/bin/lsb_release -i],,"like","Ubuntu")=1
triggers.name: Hey! {HOST.NAME} has no Basic Ubuntu server metapackage
triggers.description: if the package is not installed, then this line will not match, so throw an alert

triggers.expression: last(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/vfs.file.exists[/etc/update-motd.d/90-updates-available])=0 and last(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/vfs.file.exists[/etc/debian_version])<>1
triggers.name: Hey! {HOST.NAME} has no update-notifier-common package installed
triggers.description: If /etc/update-motd.d/90-updates-available file doesn't exist then package update-notifier-common is not installed and therefore, alert us to this fact.

triggers.expression: last(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/vfs.file.regmatch[/etc/apt/apt.conf.d/50unattended-upgrades,^\s+\"o\=Debian\Wa\=stable\-updates\"\;,UTF8,,])=0 and find(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/system.run[/usr/bin/lsb_release -i],,"like","Debian")=1
triggers.name: Hey! {HOST.NAME} non-security updates not enabled in /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/50unattended-upgrades (Debian)
triggers.description: If automatic install of non-security updates is not enabled in /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/50unattended-upgrades throw an alert

triggers.expression: last(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/vfs.file.regmatch[/etc/apt/apt.conf.d/50unattended-upgrades,\s+\"\$\{distro\_id}\:\$\{distro\_codename\}\-updates\"\;,UTF8,,])=0 and find(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/system.run[/usr/bin/lsb_release -i],,"like","Ubuntu")=1
triggers.name: Hey! {HOST.NAME} non-security updates not enabled in /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/50unattended-upgrades (Ubuntu)
triggers.description: If automatic install of non-security updates is not enabled in /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/50unattended-upgrades throw an alert

triggers.expression: last(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/vfs.file.regmatch[/etc/apt/apt.conf.d/50unattended-upgrades,Unattended-Upgrade\:\:Remove\-Unused\-Kernel\-Packages\s+\"true\"\;,UTF8,,])=0 and find(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/system.run[/usr/bin/lsb_release -c],,"like","trusty")=0 and find(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/system.run[/usr/bin/lsb_release -c],,"like","xenial")=0 and find(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/system.run[/usr/bin/lsb_release -i],,"like","Debian")=0
triggers.name: Hey! {HOST.NAME} Remove-Unused-Kernel-Packages not enabled in /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/50unattended-upgrades
triggers.description:
If Remove-Unused-Kernel-Packages is not enabled in /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/50unattended-upgrades throw an alert.

also checks if the distro, e..g xenial or trusty as some distros do not include the purge kernels line, and the Distro ID for Debian as Debian does not use this line either.

triggers.expression: last(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/vfs.file.regmatch[/etc/apt/apt.conf.d/50unattended-upgrades,^\s*\"origin\=Debian\Wcodename\=\$\{distro_codename}\Wlabel\=Debian\-Security\"\;,UTF8,,])=0 and find(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/system.run[/usr/bin/lsb_release -i],,"like","debian")=1
triggers.name: Hey! {HOST.NAME} security updates not enabled in /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/50unattended-upgrades (Debian)
triggers.description: If automatic install of security updates is not enabled in /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/50unattended-upgrades throw an alert this trigger is for Debian Linux only

triggers.expression: last(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/vfs.file.regmatch[/etc/apt/apt.conf.d/50unattended-upgrades,^\s+\"\$\{distro_id\}\:\$\{distro_codename\}\-security\"\;,UTF8,,])=0 and find(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/system.run[/usr/bin/lsb_release -i],,"like","Ubuntu")=1
triggers.name: Hey! {HOST.NAME} security updates not enabled in /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/50unattended-upgrades (Ubuntu)
triggers.description: If automatic install of security updates is not enabled in /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/50unattended-upgrades throw an alert

triggers.expression: find(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/os.release.codename,,"regexp","{$OS.EOL.CODENAMES}")=1 or find(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/os.release.id_major,,"regexp","{$OS.EOL.IDMAJOR}")=1
triggers.name: OS is end-of-life: {HOST.NAME} running {?last(/Example Music Infra Linux Unattended Upgrades/os.release.pretty_name)}
